description.value: Tim Hortons is Canada's largest coffee and quick-service restaurant chain, offering indoor seating and takeaway service. This downtown Vancouver location on Davie Street provides convenient access to food and beverages for touring cyclists. The air-conditioned, non-smoking venue serves as a reliable stop for travelers needing a break and quick meal.
